title: Why things come back, and how many each week
persona: Runs support for a small fashion store. Thinks in weeks, reads a chart faster than a table, and gets annoyed when the same reason is typed five different ways.
opening: track why customers return things and how many each week

facts.the reasons: wrong size, damaged, not as pictured, changed mind, other
facts.who records it: the support team, when the return comes in
facts.where returns come from: some through Shopify returns, some by message to support

success: the reason is one choice from a list with sensible options
there is a weekly count or chart of returns, by reason or in total
the plan is said in plain words before anything is built, with no field names or types
ends by asking whether to build
must_not: the reason kept as free text only
a field written into every row on a schedule
jargon such as "boolean" or "set_fields" in what the owner reads
